name: dynamicticketdisplay
description: Monorepo for TicketDisplay server and client

scripts.test: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const npmCmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm'; for (const workspace of ['apps/ticketdisplay-server', 'apps/ticketdisplay-client']) { spawnSync(npmCmd, ['run', 'test', '-w', workspace], { stdio: 'inherit' }); } console.error('No workspace test suites are configured yet'); process.exit(1);"
